meta.source: from scratch; v3 direction derived from the seed 8vm9HoVt45wvGIkRXJR4rMIesZ9fl43Dv57L1RS1euAPdZkOeH7NDwC53L7VNnVB
meta.target: Meta Astryx theme layer (CSS custom-property overrides)

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Flat page fallback for print and forced-colors. The live page is the page gradient with the chevron field over it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Flat card fallback; chips, inputs and tooltips.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells, table header rows, the track behind a bar.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The masthead and one callout per page. Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the page gradient (180deg to page-bottom). Text on the page is checked against both stops.

tokens.name: page-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the page gradient.

tokens.name: page-glow
tokens.usage: Teal radial glow anchored top-right of the first screen.

tokens.name: page-glow-2
tokens.usage: Orchid radial glow anchored bottom-left, the counterpoint to page-glow. Only these two glows, only these two corners.

tokens.name: card-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the card gradient (180deg to card-bottom).

tokens.name: card-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the card gradient.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: The solid 45deg offset block behind every card (shadow-3d). Ink in Light; electric teal in Dark, where it reads as a neon edge.

tokens.name: chevron-ink
tokens.usage: Ink of the chevron field laid over the page at 6% opacity in Light and 9% in Dark. The field itself is the SVG recipe in the README.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and figures on the page and card gradients and every flat surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Captions, axis labels, table cells, methodology notes, on the page and cards.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, footnotes, source lines, disabled labels, on the page and cards. Never body copy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse, card-edge and accent-strong.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Hairline card edges, table rules, gridlines. Decorative.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: The chart baseline, input edges, section rules. 3:1 on page and cards.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Electric teal, hue 174: links, the active filter, the highlighted number. As text it reads on the page, cards and surface-2.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the selected segment. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Hovered row, selected chip, the band behind a pulled quote. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Far stop of the accent gradient: accent-deep to accent at 45deg on the hero figure and the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Halo behind the highlighted bar and the hero figure.

tokens.name: counter
tokens.usage: Orchid, hue 307: the one counterpoint to teal. The slashes in an eyebrow, the focus ring, the second chart series, the bottom-left page glow. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: counter-glow
tokens.usage: Halo for a counter-colored mark, when one is highlighted instead of a teal one.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element: orchid, so it is never mistaken for a highlight. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart slot 1: this year, or the headline series. Fixed order, never cycled.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart slot 2: last year, or the comparison series.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart slot 3. Past three, fold to Other or split into small multiples.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart slot 4. Last resort.

tokens.name: series-muted
tokens.usage: Every non-highlighted bar when one bar is the point.

tokens.name: series-1-deep
tokens.usage: Baseline end of the series-1 bar gradient (deep at the baseline, series color at the free end).

tokens.name: series-2-deep
tokens.usage: Baseline end of the series-2 bar gradient.

tokens.name: series-3-deep
tokens.usage: Baseline end of the series-3 bar gradient.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: The 45deg hatch laid over the highlighted bar: 2px lines at chevron-pitch. The texture that survives print and forced-colors.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential step 1 (least). One teal ramp.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5 (most).

tokens.name: div-neg
tokens.usage: Diverging negative pole (orchid): a decline, a gap, a shortfall.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint. A neutral, never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos
tokens.usage: Diverging positive pole (teal): growth, adoption, an increase.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Good state, blue-shifted off the red-green axis. Always with an icon and a word; never a series.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state. Always with an icon and a word; never a series.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Critical state and form errors. Always with an icon and a word; never a series.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one thesis per page, uppercase, Archivo at width 125 (font-stretch: 125%). Never more than one on a screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section titles; the audience name on a landing page. Width 112.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Chart titles that make a claim; pulled quotes. Width 100.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles; the subhead under a display style.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Half of designers have shipped AI-generated code to production.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Peer learning tripled year over year, from 24% to 80%.
styles.usage: Body copy, table cells, tooltip text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Captions, axis labels, legend labels, methodology notes, in ink-2.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title or stat, opened with two slashes in counter. The audience, the section, the source.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The number on a stat tile: Archivo at width 125, so the figure is the loudest thing on the page. Never in the serif, never in the mono.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Inline comparisons and the direct label on the highlighted bar. Width 112.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Axis ticks, sample sizes, table numerals, direct labels on secondary bars. The mono is for small numbers only.

spacing.note: An 8px base (the seed opens with 8). Chart internals step by space-0.5; layout by space-2 upward.

tokens.name: space-0.25
tokens.usage: The ground-colored gap between adjacent bars and stacked segments.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a bar and its direct label; icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to title; legend swatch to label; chip padding; the notch depth on small components.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button padding; tooltip padding; gap between stat tiles on small screens.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens; the gap between a chart and its caption.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding at desktop; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its first card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter at desktop; space above a display-xl.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a body-copy column.

radius.note: Ledger does not round. Corners are square or cut at 45deg (the notch tokens under Geometry).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, bars, buttons, inputs: every corner that is not a notch.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Legend swatches and chips only, so they do not look like errors at small sizes.

geometry.note: The 45deg system: notches, the offset block, the chevron field. Every angle in Ledger is 45deg or 90deg.

tokens.name: notch-sm
tokens.usage: The cut on the top-right corner of a chip, tooltip or small card: clip-path polygon with the corner moved in by this much on both axes.

tokens.name: notch-lg
tokens.usage: The cut on the top-right corner of a card, panel or stat tile.

tokens.name: notch-xl
tokens.usage: The cut on the hero panel and the masthead.

tokens.name: offset-3d
tokens.usage: How far the card-edge block sits behind a card, down and to the right (shadow-3d).

tokens.name: offset-3d-hover
tokens.usage: The offset on hover; the card itself moves up-left by 4px so the block appears to stay still.

tokens.name: chevron-pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch of the chevron field and of the hatch on a highlighted bar.

tokens.name: chevron-angle
tokens.usage: The one angle. Chevrons, notches, hatches and the accent gradient all use it.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Card edges, table rules, gridlines in line-1; the chevron field stroke.

tokens.name: stroke-axis
tokens.usage: The chart baseline in line-2.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Line-chart series, the focus ring, the hatch lines.

tokens.name: bar-thickness
tokens.usage: Horizontal bar height. Never thicker than 32px.

shadow.note: Ledger's depth is a solid block, not a blur. The blurred shadows are only for things that float or glow.

tokens.name: shadow-3d
tokens.usage: Every card, stat tile and chart panel at rest: a solid card-edge block offset by offset-3d. Because a notched card is clipped, paint it as a pseudo-element behind the card, not as box-shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-3d-hover
tokens.usage: An interactive card on hover, with the card translated -4px -4px over 120ms.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The halo on the highlighted bar and the primary button. One element per chart.
